boundary_condition: Apply only to flight seat-location selection; do not infer preferences about cabin class, airline, route, destination, or travel dates from this habit.
condition: When selecting seats for a flight and an aisle option is available for the traveler or party.
default_action: Choose aisle seats by default rather than window or middle seats.
exception_condition: If no aisle seat is available, or the user explicitly requests a different seat type for a specific trip, do not force the aisle-seat default.
name: Flight aisle-seat default
rationale: Across independent flight-booking dialogues, users repeatedly ask for aisle seats, often with availability-scoped wording such as 'if one's available' or 'if that's possible.' This supports a controlled synthetic-user default for aisle seats when flight seats are being chosen, without treating any one route or booking as longitudinal evidence from a real person.

source_evidence.contribution: User says, 'I would just like an aisle seat, please,' directly supporting an aisle-seat preference.
User says, 'I'd prefer an aisle seat if one's available,' supporting aisle as the preferred seat type with an availability boundary.
User says, 'I would like Aisle seats, if that's possible,' supporting aisle seats as the default when possible.
User says, 'I would like aisle seats, please,' adding another independent support for aisle-seat selection.
User says, 'I want to all my seats to be an aisle seat,' supporting aisle seats for all seats in the party when applicable.
